hero.title: Protect our forests from wind turbines
hero.subtitle: Swiss federal popular initiative against the destruction of our forests by wind turbines.
hero.achievement: On 25 September 2025, the Federal Chancellery confirmed: the Forest Protection Initiative officially qualified with 107,693 valid signatures.

problem.title: Against the destruction of our forests by wind turbines
problem.body1: Nature conservation is under threat from the construction of large wind farms in Switzerland. In the name of climate protection, no one hesitates to clear vital natural areas to build enormous wind turbines. Felling trees to protect the climate is complete nonsense.
problem.body2: Several hundred wind farms and well over 1,000 wind turbines are planned across Switzerland. Many are intended to be built in the middle of forests or directly at the forest edge. Each installed turbine requires clearing an area the size of a football pitch.
problem.body3: This initiative does not ban the construction of wind turbines in Switzerland — it requires that they be planned and built clearly outside forests and forest pastures.

items.title: YES to protecting nature
items.text: Forests are threatened by the construction of wind turbines. Each turbine requires clearing an area the size of a football pitch.

items.title: YES to animal welfare
items.text: Birds and bats are struck and killed by wind turbines. Clearing destroys the habitat of many animals and insects.

items.title: YES to climate protection
items.text: The most effective way to protect the climate is to preserve natural areas, not sacrifice them.
